description.en: NVIDIA Sortformer v2.1 streaming speaker diarization model with four speaker channels, AOSC state, stable arrival-order speaker identities, and bounded-context offline and streaming execution. The model has no published language whitelist: it was trained primarily on English speech, includes non-English meeting data such as AISHELL-4 and AliMeeting, and may degrade on other languages. The checkpoint is governed by the NVIDIA Open Model License and is local-use only until redistribution approval.
description.zh: NVIDIA Sortformer v2.1 流式说话人日志模型，含四个说话人通道、AOSC 状态、稳定的到达顺序说话人身份，以及有界上下文的离线与流式执行。模型没有公布语言白名单：主要在英语语音上训练，也包含 AISHELL-4、AliMeeting 等非英语会议数据，在其他语言上可能退化。检查点受 NVIDIA Open Model License 约束，在获准再分发前仅限本地使用。

speaker_threshold.en: Speaker activity threshold used for turn decoding; default 0.5.
speaker_threshold.zh: 轮次解码所用的说话人活动阈值；默认 0.5。

speaker_min_frames.en: Minimum decoded turn duration in 80 ms model frames; default 0.
speaker_min_frames.zh: 80 ms 模型帧下的最短解码轮次时长；默认 0。

speaker_pad_frames.en: Padding applied to decoded turns in model frames; default 0.
speaker_pad_frames.zh: 对解码轮次应用的模型帧填充；默认 0。
